build_vector_head: build a vector head component that produces logits and actions for a given argument and embeds it into the vector stream
build_unit_tags_head: build a unit tags head component that produces pointer logits and actions for selecting units using attention-based keys and queries
build_target_unit_tag_head: build a target unit tag head component that produces logits for selecting a target unit from observed units using pointer networks
build_world_head: build a world head component that produces spatial logits for world coordinates using multi-scale visual streams with upsampling
build_sampling_module: build a sampling module that uses teacher forcing during training or samples from logits during inference
